review_method: Evidence-bounded assessment of the five local public paper PDFs and their frozen extracted corpus, using rubric.v1.json.
permitted_claim: Metrics may be described as agreement with the versioned ChatGPT reference labels.
separation_guarantee: Paper-quality scores are stored outside academic_retrieval and were not copied from RET relevance grades. Retrieval chunk IDs are used only as evidence pointers.
limitations: A single AI annotator cannot estimate inter-rater reliability.
All five papers are influential computer-science preprints, so score range and domain coverage are limited.
The set is suitable for engineering regression and provisional calibration, not external validity claims.
